later_events.mechanism: further amendment by EO 12156 section 1-101 (signed 1979-09-10; 44 FR 53073; no effective-date wording, read as on signing), recorded as an event, not an end: it corrects section 5-211 of EO 12148 (signed 1979-07-20; held Federal Register text), which as first issued had added "(x) the Director of the Federal" Emergency Management Agency to section 1-102 of EO 12083 without reference to EO 12121, reusing the letter (x) that EO 12121 had given the Director of the Community Services Administration; EO 12156 corrects that section to read "Section 1-102 of Executive Order No. 12083, as amended by Executive Order" No. 12121, is further amended by adding in alphabetical order (z) the Director of the Federal Emergency Management Agency. Before: section 1-102 includes members (x) and (y) added by EO 12121. After: the same members plus (z). Neither EO 12148 nor EO 12156 removes or alters the two entries added by EO 12121. The clause continues, amended, until EO 12083 is revoked.

clauses.mechanism: revocation of EO 12083 'as amended' by EO 12379 section 20, which removes the order amended by EO 12121 (no effective-date wording, read as on signing)
clauses.reason: whole: EO 12121 (signed 1979-02-26, 44 FR 11195) amends section 1-102 of EO 12083 by adding two members to the Energy Coordinating Committee, "The Director of the Community Services Administration." and "The Chairman of the Council on Wage and Price Stability."; its only command is that addition and it has no own-terms end. EO 12083 (signed 1978-09-27; held Federal Register text, 43 FR 44813, issue of September 29, 1978) has no sunset or other own-terms end. First end: EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17, 47 FR 36099), whose section 20 reads "Sec. 20. Executive O rder No. 12083, as amended, establishing the Energy" (continuing on the next line: Coordinating Committee, is revoked). EO 12379 does not name EO 12121; it revokes EO 12083 as amended, and because EO 12121's whole operative content is a textual addition to section 1-102 of EO 12083, the revocation of EO 12083 as amended removes the section it amends and ends the clause. EO 12379 has no effective-date wording, so the revocation is read as effective on signing, 1982-08-17. The Office of the Federal Register catalog note on this order reads "Revoked by: EO 12379, August 17, 1982". Later event: EO 12156 (signed 1979-09-10, 44 FR 53073) adds member (z), the Director of the Federal Emergency Management Agency, to section 1-102 as amended by EO 12121 and leaves the two members added by EO 12121 in place, so it is a later amendment event, not an end (owner ruling 2026-10-21, strike-and-insert). Disclosed earlier candidates under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on unnamed instruments (option C; neither names EO 12121, so neither is the end): (1) the Community Services Administration. An Office of the Federal Register editorial note in the held 1989 codification text (jobs/ofr-codification-1989/output/texts/EO_12344.txt, sha256 747052eb81a27f8e0040ae9c8bd5f478841e46df4e9ba7c683587599624bdbf8; the same note is in EO_12160.txt) states that "The Community Services Administration was abolished through" the repeal of the Economic Opportunity Act of 1964 "by Pub . L. 97-35 (95 Stat . 519, 42 U.S.C. 2941)". The note gives no effective date and the statute is not held, so the date the Director's office ceased is not fixed by a held source beyond falling in or after 1981 and before EO 12379. (2) The Council on Wage and Price Stability. An editorial note in the held 1989 codification text (jobs/ofr-codification-1989/output/texts/EO_12154.txt, sha256 bff5d25514c124e6fc4decb93eeae7ae824204d396dcb03bca755207208da54a) states that "The Council on Wage and Price Stability was abolished by Execu-" tive Order 12288 of Jan. 29, 1981. The held Federal Register text of EO 12288 (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12288.txt, sha256 995315c4dc9f143a80b008ebfff389f119a3d67afbba6f82fc37508a35da5e6d) does not abolish the Council: it revokes EO 12092 and authorizes the heads of agencies, "including" the Council on Wage and Price Stability, to take steps to terminate actions adopted under EO 12092, which treats the Council as still existing. No held source fixes when the Council ceased, so it is not established that both offices had ceased before 1982-08-17. Even if both had ceased, the Energy Coordinating Committee continued under EO 12083 with its other members, the added entries remained text of section 1-102, and under the ruling the end is the instrument that revokes the amended order, EO 12379. Disclosed alternative reading: if a reviewer holds that an order not named by number is not ended by the revocation of its amended parent, no first end is shown in the held sources.
